field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disabled aliases are not watched and their table is flushed.

field.label: Alias name
field.help: Name of the firewall alias (type "External") that holds the learned addresses. It is created automatically and can be used in rules like any other alias.

field.label: Domain patterns
field.help: Names to watch: "example.com" matches only that name, "*.example.com" matches every name below example.com (but not example.com itself). Add both if you need both.

field.label: Address families
field.help: Which address types (A/AAAA records and HTTPS hints) to add to the table.

field.label: Maximum entries
field.help: Upper limit for the table size. When reached, the entries closest to expiry are removed first.
